Deterministic + tested (77/77): the engine re-runs identically offline, so a live cycle spends tokens on data, not on re-deriving logic.

entry_intelligence.conviction_score: reporter.conviction_score ranks eligible entries: 0.35*delta(win-prob) + 0.30*RVOL(volume conviction) + 0.20*momentum + 0.10*above_VWAP + 0.05*IV-fit. Picks the strongest setup -> higher base win rate.
entry_intelligence.expected_move_exits: nodes.expected_move_exits derives target/stop from IV + greeks: EM = spot*IV*sqrt(hold/252), option move ~ delta*EM + 0.5*gamma*EM^2. Target = a REACHABLE 0.35-sigma fraction (low-IV -> nearer target you hit often; high-IV -> wider), initial stop = 0.4-sigma, clamped [15..200]% / [-45..-8]%. Feeds the progressive_stop initial + the scale-out target. Falls back to flat +50/-30 when greeks missing.

barbell_runner_strategy.authorized_by: user 8/4: 'lock win early = my scale-out to make sure I'm profit on the day for sure, but let some continue for 1000% growth with a strict trailing stop'
barbell_runner_strategy.applies_to: options-watchlist runners; requires >=2 contracts (prefer 2x-small sizing so scale-out is possible)
barbell_runner_strategy.principle: ALWAYS BE REALIZING: bank tranches of profit on the way UP (not just trail paper gains), so growth is continuously locked as realized $ while a final piece keeps running. Maximize overall gains, but every leg realizes profit.
barbell_runner_strategy.leg_A_day_lock: SCALE OUT ~half at the first target (+30-50%) to BANK guaranteed profit -> secures the DAY green for sure (target.scale_out_frac). Once realized day P&L is green and covers this trade's cost, the remainder is HOUSE MONEY.
barbell_runner_strategy.leg_B_moonshot: Runner rides for big gains on a TIERED trailing stop that TIGHTENS at extreme gains: give back 40% of peak while developing, 20% past +100%, and only 5% past +200% (~'trail at 100% of gains under peak') so a +300%->+150% collapse can't happen. Armed after the target; never-red + progressive_stop underneath. Marketable exits.
barbell_runner_strategy.why: Barbell = guaranteed green day (leg A) + a continuously-realized, protected moonshot (leg B). You always lock/realize growth on the way up AND keep a piece for the 10x; the strict trail protects the big number without paperhanding it. Single-contract positions can't scale - they use never-red + give-back (or size to 2-3 lots to enable tranche realization).
barbell_runner_strategy.engine: BUILT v4.5: reporter.size_order() fills the per-trade cap with up to 3 lots (same risk envelope, enables scale-out); reporter.materialize_exit_rules() auto-stamps leg-A scale-out + leg-B strict giveback (0.20) on any >=2-lot entry (single lot -> never-red runner), index scalps get the VWAP trail. Wired into the entry action (qty + exit_rules). Small live BP (~$200) usually resolves to 1 lot until cheaper contracts / more BP.

funnel_checkpoints.PREMARKET_0800_0915: BROAD SCREEN: market-wide run_scan (RVOL, gappers both directions, % change) -> funnel_candidates -> funnel_filter (all GUARDRAILS pre-checks) -> funnel_rank -> top 3-5 singles that pass EVERYTHING join SPY/QQQ. funnel_checkpoints.BETWEEN_CHECKPOINTS: Dynamic re-rank of the CURRENT list every scan (already live). A brand-new name enters mid-stream ONLY on exceptional flow + full gate pass (rare by design - avoids churn/chase; afternoon posture raises the bar further).
funnel_checkpoints.principle: Screen wide at the two checkpoints, execute narrow always. Specifically-triggered tickers that meet ALL scoring requirements get slots; nothing squats (META 8/5), nothing gets chased.
